reason: I'd probably grab the free week, but I don't pay for workouts. Once it ran out I'd go back to the free postpartum videos on YouTube whenever the baby naps.
objection: There are free postpartum and pelvic floor workouts on YouTube, so I'm not sure what $20 gets me beyond a group chat and a check-in I may never reply to.
would_change_my_mind: If the free week actually made a noticeable dent in the leaking when I sneeze or jump, or a physio told me this program does it properly where YouTube doesn't.
